brief: Carries out the LockAccount and RevokeSession actions of a response plan on a stzAuth.
detail: A response plan proposes containment as data; a responder performs verbs for real once a committing actor approves. This one answers the two that authentication owns: LockAccount closes every login path of an account with the reason locked by a containment plan, and RevokeSession ends every session of a user. The other four verbs raise an error that names the responder to wire. It holds the stzAuth by reference, so the caller's object sees the change.
receiver:
oAuth = new stzAuth()
oAuth.Register("dana", "invented-pw")
o1 = new stzAuthResponder(oAuth)
